{"rich_text":"

「别看他斯斯文文，其实…其实也是个惹事精啊。」——常年受害的重云如此说道。 

璃月港飞云商会的二少爷行秋自幼便以勤奋好学、待人礼貌闻名。大人们提起他，总是赞不绝口，无不盼着自家孩子像他一样优秀。

不过，静若处子的行秋也有着动若脱兔的时候。父亲与大哥都不知道，这个乖孩子会将武侠小说塞进挖了洞的课本带到私塾品读，闲暇时也常四处游荡，偷偷处理各种不为人知的小麻烦。

甚至有时，连飞云商会也被牵扯其中，只是行秋才智过人，总能找到搪塞的理由，将种种歪理说得无懈可击。人们辩不过他，久而久之，便也习惯了小少爷古灵精怪的一面。

热爱读书的行秋一直梦想，要像话本中的大侠那样行侠仗义。侠之一字对行秋来说，既是方向也是思路。侠之大者，不因小挫折气馁，不以小欢喜止步，更要抓住机遇，促成一切仁义之事。

年少轻轻，身上已兼具侠之仁义与侠之奇思。正是这份天赋，使行秋成为了重振古华派武术的传奇之人。人们慕名而来恳求见古华派大师，得到的却只有门童羞涩的回复：「大师上山偷懒去了，各位择日再来吧。」 

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":false}

{"rich_text":"

璃月港的商人都知道，飞云商会里有一位行秋少爷。

在旁人看来，行秋待人温和有礼，又勤奋好学，是年轻一代中的翘楚。

作为家族次子，商会事务尚不需要行秋主持。但在各大巨贾子弟中，行秋拥有罕见的读书天赋，向来受教书先生们赞赏。

家中那位正在向老爹学习经商与持家的大哥，也认为行秋将来必成大器。

殊不知，行秋看完厚度惊人的经商总集与贤人哲思以后，会把它们从中间挖空，塞进武侠小说看个不停。

偶尔，行秋也会突然消失。旁人问及去了哪里、做了什么时，他总是回答：「偷得浮生半日闲」。

{"list":[{"tab_name":"汉语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"在下行秋，不过书海一蠹。某虽不才，仍愿为君略尽绵薄。难得有机会说这种风格的台词，感觉还不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/246787c7a5fa7d00881c09b28cff96c1_3548156909008814791.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无人夜","content":"「有时明月无人夜，独向昭潭制恶龙。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a5bb544e41cf074342150428a5e843a9_4119454521412237280.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·文章","content":"「衣裓贮文章，自言学雕虫。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/52e3dc0288103ab835fc4070997a13bb_5770794313656930213.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·偷闲","content":"正所谓「偷得浮生半日闲」，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/be69c56b9a3e3aff83cdf52425aa74bc_5678434454939352512.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·阅卷","content":"如此如此，这般这般…欸？欲知后事如何，且听下回分解？唔…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e62018a4133892bf48c7cb268baca634_1767914918954130672.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·新书","content":"盘算着也该到「万文集舍」新进小说的日子了，不妨…我们顺道去看看？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f8d98c5a11d0d23cc71aac2157e7a4f3_8866716471191357771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"这么说来，我们家出品的锦缎伞，好像既不能遮阳也不能挡雨。唯一的用处就是挂在墙上。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/28ebb6f1073d7ebcec57914be99b378e_5839091594226853833.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"晴了就好，不然藏书会生霉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b8bd604d0c0644848812205ab421f5ad_3666823370589400525.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"只有这种天气的时候，我才会觉得家里比书店好。家里炭火很足，而书堆里就不准用火。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9be7a580d9a5a63c6a6c60978034fcc6_2240785895681858362.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"练功的好…啊不，是看书的好时节啊。好啦，我脸上又没有写字，别一直盯着我看了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c09d932ec67968b60fb405315ee85471_4650045368632716842.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早啊。早上的时间这么难得，能做做自己喜欢的事情就好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/05f47fb08f5fed54d0fb0ce4c33bc0f5_317508042539469799.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭有点不想吃米饭，想吃糕点。待在书斋吃，父亲和兄长就不知道了…嗯？想一起来吗？嗯…只要你不把碎屑沾到书上就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7964676032a1c21fb79d438b2a129c71_1740464372800157464.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"去偷点萤火虫来看书，怎么样？唔，我的玩笑话你可别当真，对眼睛不好的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/219457fee727f2b440aa75fb866cff65_3037901495594241592.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"明天我也在老地方。只要你不中途迷了路，就准能找得到我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/01ff025aaef99a242786b97ee8bb0b09_2204012408261674529.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋自己…","content":"在人前彬彬有礼，是因为大家见我是飞云商会的二少爷；在你面前能这么轻松，大概因为你看我的方式并不一样吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c93b2e38cbd5081f1132d5462a0cad44_7887698126653058304.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·书友","content":"你算是我的书友吧。什么？打架？古华派？战友？…唔！你都在说些什么呢。不是说好这是我们两人间的秘密吗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/045e03beb327444084f1c6f655a9e0f9_887223783804590626.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·结拜","content":"我要和你结拜，就去绝云间的祭坛那边。不行，不能拒绝。你知道了我的底细，也就知道了一直被我掩饰着的真实的自己…我不能放你走。除非…你答应我不会撒手不干！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e0d97c673a135f51f84485fca31b9d1_3137983967038751211.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·古书","content":"「神之眼」的事情，虽然一般少有记载，但在我所收集的古书中却有一段特别的描述，待我找给你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e99d7a31ffb434c8763e5a25adde5a4a_5788303096420673494.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·领悟","content":"受书中启发，我领会到，枪术与剑术的本质，正是瞳术。唔，解释起来可能有点费力…如果你真想知道，就跟我去「王山厅」走一趟吧。事先声明，到时候你可不准笑。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/49822612e78ef8503a699d87f3cb9cf2_6294676475517842213.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月非去不可的地方？这个问题很难回答，不过，如果消失了会让我很难过的地方…「万文集舍」稳排第一，「古华堂」能进前十吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2529042b38d74dab40adf187cc455b84_7764589090937850491.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"以前是兔子，后来是鹿。对我来说，「请从绝处，读我侠义」是舍弃一切的觉悟，鹿却是绝处逢得新生的希望。真想再见它一次啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e5e78eddc1fe0f59c9f8d12dba6817ee_6407462060464980740.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"北斗阁下是我非常敬重的人。不过希望她不要喊我「小子」，也不要一见面就揉我头发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/72dcb489cc953fd3f90cb6a24264166a_1863094787201589340.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"「天权」大人是我不得不敬重的人。不然会给家父以及家兄添麻烦。嗯？对她本人，我想想。嗯…还是算了，不说人坏话了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c9e3dfd495d3c7d2653c98eb1bf9b875_1680023819583858286.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d64cd22e22420db808ba5d2323ecb629_4974231470325543505.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2222838a2a09acc4df4f6c4beda50641_8590642543992868435.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"那个小姑娘，正是「往生堂」的当代堂主。嗯？问我怎样看待她的为人？…行事作风嘛，坊间传闻是作不了数的。真想了解一个人，还得看她真正想要的是什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c565a25b0c22b7fe199f507012b87a8_8281972450455547039.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"总感觉七七的身上藏着谜团。但只要白术先生在场，就跟她说不上几句话。除非，我们能找个白术先生外出看诊的机会，专门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b28dca7afc37c8102988628873c6a7b8_7158534783510059444.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"见到香菱的时候，你可得多观察一下她的表情。尤其是刚刚添置完食材回来的香菱，笑得越开心，就越危险。要是被她缠上、逼你试吃新品…这种情况，我一般会靠重云来处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/61187188c7532c89b0d93b44394573e3_1181340807018553195.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"辛焱到底是在哪里演出的？从吃虎岩到玉京台，哪里都躲不过那种鸡飞狗跳的穿透力…唉，能够安静看书的时日是多么宝贵啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/adc44aab5982e4871e18e512c4a2af2d_1755984538647392519.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"下一卷、下下卷、下下下卷的重要场景，我都已经想好要配怎样的插画了！啊，必须赶快把灵感记下来，修书一封，寄给白垩老师…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/01ec1f456e62581b357707e98a4205ee_2367889403543893772.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我看见过家父和家兄接待这位先生，就从他们行礼时候的恭敬态度来看…对方应该是很有地位的人物吧。我还听说他是给仙人办丧事的人，感觉很有底蕴。要不要一起去挖掘他身上的秘密呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02778abf1c26b911804666c1dcd6528e_6609294832624266544.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/79eed08ebabad1018631fd18a7581001_1683508830100960506.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"你听说过「一人千面」这个词语吗？夜兰小姐就给我这种感觉。上门来访的时候，家父和家兄以礼相待，她也还之以礼，就像是个亲切稳重的大姐姐。可在别的地方见到她时，又完全是不同的印象。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0a495b7eacb68ea0adc4fc8ab2fb2247_7237498255731655020.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于嘉明…","content":"嘉明的工作颇有侠之风范。试想，功夫盖世的黑衣少年携手威武镇煞的瑞兽，在月黑风高夜，将盗贼与恶徒打得落花流水，狼狈而逃…等他得空，真想听他多分享一些走镖路途中的见闻。你也一起来吧？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/01/17/16576950/ea559ca2bce1ed4d70280d1e5546ea18_7203352222725136980.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34关于嘉明…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其一","content":"阁下近来可好？如果闲来无事，可以来「万文集舍」转转。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cecf74f5b5ff86469eee7360acea0f39_5011274352672272264.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其二","content":"问我为什么总是一个人看书？好学…并不是什么坏习惯吧。没有什么特别的地方，嗯，真的没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f8e9844fd4bcf7558b632aa97d7e8c26_4493308994845546562.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其三","content":"今天的时间已经空出来了吗？好，我也随时可以出发。书？没关系，书可以回来接着看，那些需要我们帮助的人可不能等啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a5c8ea9c5bae08db4bc5e620569ec12c_3489325563981022093.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其四","content":"你说你有个好点子？用我们之前做的事情当原型，写一本探案集加武侠题材的小说，《万文集事件簿》？嗯，啊哈哈哈…是个好点子，但是不采纳。嗯，不会采纳的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c3bed1391bf401648127fb438d46faf_1813900029711290731.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其五","content":"「洋洋万言，织诗成锦。」唉，我也想有这样的评价啊。这件事我只和你一个人说。其实，我也在写小说。现、现在当然不能给你看，以后…以后你会在书店里看到的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/813b2a8080ce47899a64ae21ca2f144b_7508699386288731315.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的爱好…","content":"我的爱好自然是看书。什么书都会看。嗯？你一脸坏笑看着我干什么。唔，那事我们两个知道就行了，还是不适合明面上讲。说出来就没意思了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1b2b81686cbce51eb81de2e0c1fd91bc_682073966920121746.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的烦恼…","content":"烦恼啊，嗯…未来有朝一日兄长继承了家业，我会怎么样呢？这样无忧无虑的生活恐怕…啊，我不是在说身份之类的，我不在乎那些。我是觉得大哥太呆了，没我帮忙不太行啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0f2dc47e3986c2941b3487dd133003e7_8324359673430656262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我比较喜欢吃糕点和月菜海鲜。主要是因为，我们家一直就吃得很清淡吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/52b5ee2c0aa13e035fd61d6ab40954ff_2178942123539671844.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我很讨厌胡萝卜，小时候家母经常捣碎胡萝卜做成…还是不要让我讲下去了。即使是在回忆里，那种味道也…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/560fd7dab9c018dbb35ab751a569703e_7348016866851921712.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"此等美食，吃过一次就再难忘怀了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ab7a6aee1ddcd7f06853abb09e0f75bf_5788768974016145034.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"既然你有这份手艺，不如我们开个路边餐馆，如何？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a74bbb0affd204b02885cb3849eb9b4c_1339169795956741006.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你吃你吃，不必客气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e05abc6bfd6ff7491f3bd45be72ae576_6951704093673971894.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·祝福","content":"咳，咳咳。恭祝你福寿与天齐，庆贺你生辰快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3562fc0dd0a739200186cca41ed43529_3281113994561596617.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·习俗","content":"据记载，天成石桥是上古战争时候，岩之神摩拉克斯投出的石枪倒塌后形成的。要是生日当天在桥上走一趟，往两边海里投点摩拉，就能保佑一年安康…生日一年只有一次，想去的话就快点去吧…没骗你，是真的。真的，快去吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7584d8b8d74849998153c06af90e4cd9_1348438922139540914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"如果没有能力，那我心中的那个字，可能也就停在纸面上了吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7a6105f8073e96ebfd32d9949ef83cb3_966699740639772400.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"如果心中没有善恶的标尺，努力就会错了方向。舍本逐末，变成追逐暴力的俗人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae2dece8ccee1a3a66d68df37a8da694_4271320719541331287.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"我所追求的那个字，在璃月这方土地上并非处处通行。不过行道至此，我对这一点早就有了足够的认识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77bd2ff25b399e9224d17b91d8df5275_6927165273915252101.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"多亏了你的陪伴。我对自己也很满意了——无论是武学，还是对那个字的理解。唉，算啦。我也不用对「侠」字讳莫如深了。我的「侠」，父亲和兄长应该也不会质疑了。只不过嘛，低调行事这点还是得保留的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1cb06812430b800b50d50746efd1eec5_6776849572170457305.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"雨线难画。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/253c055ce194d17ca6fc50d535a3d008_3911388063612842577.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"裁——！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/11bf907d6ae348fdbad4fe2918df1c79_858923339669263899.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"断！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d541449c538883b1a1f25b3d0da527f9_5346034521285877697.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"古华深秘。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/51edd49f464e358dfcf5ce4ea6a07555_1777630822610047191.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"织诗成锦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/58f7c9d95b15eb0abc0eeadcfc8cf032_8746747433068972281.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"裁雨留虹。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2158b82c2cfd840e9175514a79b8d260_3151092309475920729.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其一","content":"形随神至。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd9b098ee36b8ef53be0bec8bf05490b_5137493443858336345.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其二","content":"该行动了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/306218a638fec514891b3b401e51a7e1_4630386586684749294.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"甚好甚好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b038868a581539e24e94452bf752f8d1_3545447070741165050.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"寻得珍宝，真是充满侠意的经历。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/88d7c3dd519d71e5d9ccf9edd60a1a55_86367277045164016.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"倘若还有几卷失传的古书，就完满了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33bccdd7d3f80cf98db57dacaae65d9a_1960321922653232819.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"计划有变…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33d53cb0cc64aa962e90978a5257d45b_5033756428226084663.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"接下来就不再是「点到为止」了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f28b542dc7ee83a907f6c3cf949d086d_3074666049543775111.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"「请从绝处，读我侠义。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02da249f4e3f992db5e2d50a636c2d20_7036978012903152677.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"过来这边，我有一计。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/74dcdf35b02833ee2820ed4f965f2ccb_8717646863548914797.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"小心行事为好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a2db360f0cabfbf030b141e8567264a1_7438558278444443541.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"承蒙…赐教…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/beec93d8749d4fc382d16d3a6a421290_1407970315698161175.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"灯华易散…我是知道的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2861c5786fa7c387ef4a2414b4f043c1_5989528085575310595.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"失手了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/63813483ffc85bda53ddcbd82a2c94e1_3830626905642801793.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不妨事。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7bbab6ec9c722adc964a620b23179fd9_234404592143764666.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"大意了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a9be589795003aca5a371171da051e32_5196775883232674187.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"不好…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/091bafd192cb9be5e527765d9f112f68_2460318344880377663.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"厚积而薄发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7bc10697c7b8de6e78b4039a05736f7d_245445870178637372.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"不惭世上英。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/897f9982a79108396e03398bb0207485_8729966396637742911.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"扶善惩恶，当仁不让。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f230698abe8962c388f7eb5067ed3e5e_5910194884247450735.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701365281501_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"在下行秋，不过书海一蠹。某虽不才，仍愿为君略尽绵薄。难得有机会说这种风格的台词，感觉还不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e2480891fdc65bc21b573c8226e4b8b1_1482487256291611351.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无人夜","content":"「有时明月无人夜，独向昭潭制恶龙。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c9d0cebe22c48c9e56b94479894f456f_849051056319913028.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·文章","content":"「衣裓贮文章，自言学雕虫。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9b7561b7f22155fab013037161217517_8105780065127873333.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·偷闲","content":"正所谓「偷得浮生半日闲」，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ad29a63e61fc6056565e472c8910aea3_7284183641410855988.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·阅卷","content":"如此如此，这般这般…欸？欲知后事如何，且听下回分解？唔…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1df4d5b4e7ec8b6f50c525538615900d_2203613306617453197.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·新书","content":"盘算着也该到「万文集舍」新进小说的日子了，不妨…我们顺道去看看？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5fb499f5e32a0036a878978ec9c39836_5362681064718294535.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"这么说来，我们家出品的锦缎伞，好像既不能遮阳也不能挡雨。唯一的用处就是挂在墙上。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e213e02090c409c6f9e6652b94cbb8b4_4374459715893906831.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"晴了就好，不然藏书会生霉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b7c51b8fccdedb117a854262560546e1_9005071793921537278.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"只有这种天气的时候，我才会觉得家里比书店好。家里炭火很足，而书堆里就不准用火。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/db234b55057b0179c0033693b7480376_2670882148946450521.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"练功的好…啊不，是看书的好时节啊。好啦，我脸上又没有写字，别一直盯着我看了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/73d445a438330b0f4429d95ed0ada815_5959250912473543134.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早啊。早上的时间这么难得，能做做自己喜欢的事情就好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e95c83e5fd49b4ae907fc50530349ca1_6125280864222509611.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭有点不想吃米饭，想吃糕点。待在书斋吃，父亲和兄长就不知道了…嗯？想一起来吗？嗯…只要你不把碎屑沾到书上就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f4c6034af7022b5c93d2f43fbcc1d6b7_8763389738492618177.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"去偷点萤火虫来看书，怎么样？唔，我的玩笑话你可别当真，对眼睛不好的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e066c9b95842786ecba123e63185db45_2668133239968304071.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"明天我也在老地方。只要你不中途迷了路，就准能找得到我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f0aa0e63e6237d24addbee56324f669d_5608679476467751176.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋自己…","content":"在人前彬彬有礼，是因为大家见我是飞云商会的二少爷；在你面前能这么轻松，大概因为你看我的方式并不一样吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef3ec89989c6d323fb5eef11ddaecc44_6790536167095039335.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·书友","content":"你算是我的书友吧。什么？打架？古华派？战友？…唔！你都在说些什么呢。不是说好这是我们两人间的秘密吗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2d9fae4d826888ae21a2df2089c08e5b_6201046492497712378.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·结拜","content":"我要和你结拜，就去绝云间的祭坛那边。不行，不能拒绝。你知道了我的底细，也就知道了一直被我掩饰着的真实的自己…我不能放你走。除非…你答应我不会撒手不干！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb9f986521232fc42ae10f1e1ec613e8_1540952127824436053.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·古书","content":"「神之眼」的事情，虽然一般少有记载，但在我所收集的古书中却有一段特别的描述，待我找给你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/97aee15f78941e5bd978cb5613f4ce68_8535085859617961274.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·领悟","content":"受书中启发，我领会到，枪术与剑术的本质，正是瞳术。唔，解释起来可能有点费力…如果你真想知道，就跟我去「王山厅」走一趟吧。事先声明，到时候你可不准笑。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/578e14fae02c5bca20eca8f2efebb4e2_1171257691875347883.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月非去不可的地方？这个问题很难回答，不过，如果消失了会让我很难过的地方…「万文集舍」稳排第一，「古华堂」能进前十吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31c17974ad6207d7dee504e6fad83077_7150830078047971274.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"以前是兔子，后来是鹿。对我来说，「请从绝处，读我侠义」是舍弃一切的觉悟，鹿却是绝处逢得新生的希望。真想再见它一次啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ce75650598267b4efa987e9c9a0d7c61_8049539826871681032.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"北斗阁下是我非常敬重的人。不过希望她不要喊我「小子」，也不要一见面就揉我头发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c91e9d8da5836433902ecb88fa04fd99_3812584111010417175.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"「天权」大人是我不得不敬重的人。不然会给家父以及家兄添麻烦。嗯？对她本人，我想想。嗯…还是算了，不说人坏话了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/92b25f6f1bda450211e74562b4356b75_404661509331778922.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a7285872c6b60ea96305318703bff74c_1861951327626990290.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c7f4acc0f041da3788ec697553f1282_3372774977871176875.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"那个小姑娘，正是「往生堂」的当代堂主。嗯？问我怎样看待她的为人？…行事作风嘛，坊间传闻是作不了数的。真想了解一个人，还得看她真正想要的是什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9417088f0da79629b3f89945ff831ce8_6399282270761300072.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"总感觉七七的身上藏着谜团。但只要白术先生在场，就跟她说不上几句话。除非，我们能找个白术先生外出看诊的机会，专门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6ad66b288cba3639d07a32cab78ff248_332040021821005753.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"见到香菱的时候，你可得多观察一下她的表情。尤其是刚刚添置完食材回来的香菱，笑得越开心，就越危险。要是被她缠上、逼你试吃新品…这种情况，我一般会靠重云来处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/990ed3b87c3110d64d214583f086e0e9_3451600758983593318.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"辛焱到底是在哪里演出的？从吃虎岩到玉京台，哪里都躲不过那种鸡飞狗跳的穿透力…唉，能够安静看书的时日是多么宝贵啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/230fa7aa535ff81e7316ab389665cb19_7323603913969762500.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"下一卷、下下卷、下下下卷的重要场景，我都已经想好要配怎样的插画了！啊，必须赶快把灵感记下来，修书一封，寄给白垩老师…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c147b331de9ae2a4bd7f6ddc5a1b51d_2840466395028586396.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我看见过家父和家兄接待这位先生，就从他们行礼时候的恭敬态度来看…对方应该是很有地位的人物吧。我还听说他是给仙人办丧事的人，感觉很有底蕴。要不要一起去挖掘他身上的秘密呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0f68e8ca518c9b05114d7004063bdf5_8000365744154500921.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2b7b828c8998c555f670473c0f2a4338_53164972460336317.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"你听说过「一人千面」这个词语吗？夜兰小姐就给我这种感觉。上门来访的时候，家父和家兄以礼相待，她也还之以礼，就像是个亲切稳重的大姐姐。可在别的地方见到她时，又完全是不同的印象。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/da7fd07ed466a0783be6bb6924ee0a39_166084939576284726.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于嘉明…","content":"嘉明的工作颇有侠之风范。试想，功夫盖世的黑衣少年携手威武镇煞的瑞兽，在月黑风高夜，将盗贼与恶徒打得落花流水，狼狈而逃…等他得空，真想听他多分享一些走镖路途中的见闻。你也一起来吧？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/01/17/16576950/ed6f742f9ee718fc91655fdadcdb62b6_1367017553394628617.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34关于嘉明…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其一","content":"阁下近来可好？如果闲来无事，可以来「万文集舍」转转。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4af13d40bad007fe3a58ff3142126612_1770898813275195613.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其二","content":"问我为什么总是一个人看书？好学…并不是什么坏习惯吧。没有什么特别的地方，嗯，真的没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/89c67b4e851c4d299c48e21d4a7de1fb_2782587096898501358.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其三","content":"今天的时间已经空出来了吗？好，我也随时可以出发。书？没关系，书可以回来接着看，那些需要我们帮助的人可不能等啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8dc9f2b2bb48a68067e58bc96a005883_4396031120529482202.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其四","content":"你说你有个好点子？用我们之前做的事情当原型，写一本探案集加武侠题材的小说，《万文集事件簿》？嗯，啊哈哈哈…是个好点子，但是不采纳。嗯，不会采纳的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a5a7117bf57e6cbfa2f87b32a60a051_3102361547323583075.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其五","content":"「洋洋万言，织诗成锦。」唉，我也想有这样的评价啊。这件事我只和你一个人说。其实，我也在写小说。现、现在当然不能给你看，以后…以后你会在书店里看到的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7b6ef15dd6112399aa41d5408c9ce52a_5798315280609721569.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的爱好…","content":"我的爱好自然是看书。什么书都会看。嗯？你一脸坏笑看着我干什么。唔，那事我们两个知道就行了，还是不适合明面上讲。说出来就没意思了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/38eb8bef4ff7ce611eba1840a4820b55_8660620187164585761.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的烦恼…","content":"烦恼啊，嗯…未来有朝一日兄长继承了家业，我会怎么样呢？这样无忧无虑的生活恐怕…啊，我不是在说身份之类的，我不在乎那些。我是觉得大哥太呆了，没我帮忙不太行啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b0fa7b2f11c5e218fff9fc8c6d18c48b_2728848949689143389.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我比较喜欢吃糕点和月菜海鲜。主要是因为，我们家一直就吃得很清淡吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ee5e150bbf2c9702e83bab6fbea5d61e_7823279332308858616.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我很讨厌胡萝卜，小时候家母经常捣碎胡萝卜做成…还是不要让我讲下去了。即使是在回忆里，那种味道也…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9385be065c09da584941f585d3b5d7c2_4908806039390754689.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"此等美食，吃过一次就再难忘怀了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e3b9a93e33456a953baf74fc091efe96_2504239703476410626.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"既然你有这份手艺，不如我们开个路边餐馆，如何？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ae51b0c8eff666acb391b57c4fccedf2_3867311603541866197.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你吃你吃，不必客气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/277e96412cb72326cfccc7abec59ca91_5882751416761071156.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·祝福","content":"咳，咳咳。恭祝你福寿与天齐，庆贺你生辰快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d11f4083a1b2a09cde9b8abdc4c222d9_7440297882608165692.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·习俗","content":"据记载，天成石桥是上古战争时候，岩之神摩拉克斯投出的石枪倒塌后形成的。要是生日当天在桥上走一趟，往两边海里投点摩拉，就能保佑一年安康…生日一年只有一次，想去的话就快点去吧…没骗你，是真的。真的，快去吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd11d9182b77a187a62f0df5e30268ab_2407664080647321664.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"如果没有能力，那我心中的那个字，可能也就停在纸面上了吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/daefa7d5b27a91468147a0af984c16f6_6695041660555279523.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"如果心中没有善恶的标尺，努力就会错了方向。舍本逐末，变成追逐暴力的俗人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/280d95e1e78223742e8be7a3d01ed964_2467364240925359695.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"我所追求的那个字，在璃月这方土地上并非处处通行。不过行道至此，我对这一点早就有了足够的认识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2d57b79492ecabe415fccc5ba7d07c54_1088132441937215099.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"多亏了你的陪伴。我对自己也很满意了——无论是武学，还是对那个字的理解。唉，算啦。我也不用对「侠」字讳莫如深了。我的「侠」，父亲和兄长应该也不会质疑了。只不过嘛，低调行事这点还是得保留的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a0e928f694eca632cd85562a3ab199ae_203159995811174593.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"雨线难画。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9cb6d67afc8c6f085c14c60ed2859eee_6606209461706076903.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"裁——！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5218cd6e52fbb2b9db28cdeb052f4029_5226452121454618532.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"断！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb96296662d511fd343904885d8d8b17_1858598263072711582.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"古华深秘。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9e4c2c310232bb7ba5632278ffa5e1e4_4516477056614996077.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"织诗成锦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/32b684eb017799879470a1fe60b51b5e_9133236539842664141.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"裁雨留虹。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f5c2100c72455af66b68f855343a37a7_3427499867178633992.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其一","content":"形随神至。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4fd73cd62fb6ffe963438fba62b9fca2_8712516206234326229.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其二","content":"该行动了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3022be09eb7fb1aefa80c768ba0b9b4b_9070657887991318261.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"甚好甚好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d2639d0293a1cb8ff472e9a573fd8cc1_7939697013448213069.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"寻得珍宝，真是充满侠意的经历。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.co o_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d5e6944fd3d18f11b0eebb21f1af1ce0_12009527250656434.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"不好…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c5a73b1a9a0b92dd502fd4a8f780fdd2_9105121879417910292.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"厚积而薄发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ed71d901b1cec2576c924fe1d9daf3a9_4001106326887681211.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"不惭世上英。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6207df311580ba05e574280c8fa40bb6_3874339657048009875.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"扶善惩恶，当仁不让。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e2ef5630521c29d5e2d910ee2d664de_840179982499578565.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701365281501_1"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"在下行秋，不过书海一蠹。某虽不才，仍愿为君略尽绵薄。难得有机会说这种风格的台词，感觉还不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d62f1292618a6f487dd5d1875723d7bd_5681273876015948732.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无人夜","content":"「有时明月无人夜，独向昭潭制恶龙。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/de4e903f0b759139b4bd70c5fdf9c829_5705431735287135764.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·文章","content":"「衣裓贮文章，自言学雕虫。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0591ac6dd2d362bfe730b9270685e5d9_432357989863053534.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·偷闲","content":"正所谓「偷得浮生半日闲」，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31895ca2666c15180d1ad58ac7c9e57c_2879420325989503824.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·阅卷","content":"如此如此，这般这般…欸？欲知后事如何，且听下回分解？唔…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2faa30db592d8bf92aad2fd9b229a621_1528714097426004255.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·新书","content":"盘算着也该到「万文集舍」新进小说的日子了，不妨…我们顺道去看看？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f142b86e00d1450431841fdb062f5333_8030292848585645049.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"这么说来，我们家出品的锦缎伞，好像既不能遮阳也不能挡雨。唯一的用处就是挂在墙上。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2df49ea90ee538b0d58a5da15db12314_8667118411545420678.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"晴了就好，不然藏书会生霉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fed9caa1430ef55de9ad2cdf07611473_6247912630298929432.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"只有这种天气的时候，我才会觉得家里比书店好。家里炭火很足，而书堆里就不准用火。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f470b315c999fb0fbc591a88592857d1_8016620731086384302.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"练功的好…啊不，是看书的好时节啊。好啦，我脸上又没有写字，别一直盯着我看了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2e24d9ec052ea4252c56bded39962490_3855491924613122439.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早啊。早上的时间这么难得，能做做自己喜欢的事情就好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6b856cc37c7cd4b4fca0d6ef461b5287_5512652062593551378.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭有点不想吃米饭，想吃糕点。待在书斋吃，父亲和兄长就不知道了…嗯？想一起来吗？嗯…只要你不把碎屑沾到书上就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c5c031e1b10969a4bd5af908f3a02441_2063991849555043035.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"去偷点萤火虫来看书，怎么样？唔，我的玩笑话你可别当真，对眼睛不好的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e632910ed252acd2376cca9f7f1e08f3_3947808558980051419.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"明天我也在老地方。只要你不中途迷了路，就准能找得到我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a4bbec1ee150b4860e9256dec5e71307_2352273319542752560.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋自己…","content":"在人前彬彬有礼，是因为大家见我是飞云商会的二少爷；在你面前能这么轻松，大概因为你看我的方式并不一样吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/196d2d5cd43bdf3a2ae62815e8dad5a4_4624305419434065970.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·书友","content":"你算是我的书友吧。什么？打架？古华派？战友？…唔！你都在说些什么呢。不是说好这是我们两人间的秘密吗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2cfef03939f46ea2ec4ff2c47e8b63c5_593157941202678913.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·结拜","content":"我要和你结拜，就去绝云间的祭坛那边。不行，不能拒绝。你知道了我的底细，也就知道了一直被我掩饰着的真实的自己…我不能放你走。除非…你答应我不会撒手不干！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e8dabd02c6ea922b1a0e548fe5eb4b05_44145196070940772.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·古书","content":"「神之眼」的事情，虽然一般少有记载，但在我所收集的古书中却有一段特别的描述，待我找给你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/713f5c12659e0ea502b66aeb0cea69f4_3097876101139911600.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·领悟","content":"受书中启发，我领会到，枪术与剑术的本质，正是瞳术。唔，解释起来可能有点费力…如果你真想知道，就跟我去「王山厅」走一趟吧。事先声明，到时候你可不准笑。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a569b14a9ce1f7f43478618126fce494_3204274931061749667.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月非去不可的地方？这个问题很难回答，不过，如果消失了会让我很难过的地方…「万文集舍」稳排第一，「古华堂」能进前十吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/01d7c6a00ee534f03869fe480bcb2d8a_7752569028547137559.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"以前是兔子，后来是鹿。对我来说，「请从绝处，读我侠义」是舍弃一切的觉悟，鹿却是绝处逢得新生的希望。真想再见它一次啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/14f198947d0b89d6541149387dd59066_7703632385635016086.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"北斗阁下是我非常敬重的人。不过希望她不要喊我「小子」，也不要一见面就揉我头发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e640704981b3bb959738ffcf417588c_1804489293029967176.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"「天权」大人是我不得不敬重的人。不然会给家父以及家兄添麻烦。嗯？对她本人，我想想。嗯…还是算了，不说人坏话了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f31d0154abed5bcfe6dc9e8103aa6bd6_6823328090530394341.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb10d30f363646052c84ed297f752d20_7055193356060009198.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ad844fa4d8ab26e7590db493498ac7c1_4699038330716002749.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"那个小姑娘，正是「往生堂」的当代堂主。嗯？问我怎样看待她的为人？…行事作风嘛，坊间传闻是作不了数的。真想了解一个人，还得看她真正想要的是什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/38490b434462942ad7ac79cb92e923b4_2190352561311199182.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"总感觉七七的身上藏着谜团。但只要白术先生在场，就跟她说不上几句话。除非，我们能找个白术先生外出看诊的机会，专门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f5295cfdb06d1c08ec996a8313a70cdc_5312322352937342149.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"见到香菱的时候，你可得多观察一下她的表情。尤其是刚刚添置完食材回来的香菱，笑得越开心，就越危险。要是被她缠上、逼你试吃新品…这种情况，我一般会靠重云来处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8d709a7622668af45b91e003f6284d4d_3120266798101186600.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"辛焱到底是在哪里演出的？从吃虎岩到玉京台，哪里都躲不过那种鸡飞狗跳的穿透力…唉，能够安静看书的时日是多么宝贵啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a8bfbcd71126a4d7b1e56c3e130ca55a_8061804497169643346.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"下一卷、下下卷、下下下卷的重要场景，我都已经想好要配怎样的插画了！啊，必须赶快把灵感记下来，修书一封，寄给白垩老师…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/24769bf81e8fa0497f48254934bd984e_1732763243179540176.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我看见过家父和家兄接待这位先生，就从他们行礼时候的恭敬态度来看…对方应该是很有地位的人物吧。我还听说他是给仙人办丧事的人，感觉很有底蕴。要不要一起去挖掘他身上的秘密呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d6b638b9cc378a46b1363163e2869a45_5735686656223562627.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/68a9a8d561b0a8d3f262c5c4d5e720df_8672023124873205489.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"你听说过「一人千面」这个词语吗？夜兰小姐就给我这种感觉。上门来访的时候，家父和家兄以礼相待，她也还之以礼，就像是个亲切稳重的大姐姐。可在别的地方见到她时，又完全是不同的印象。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ea1e185548373cd6f38e2fb3e65718e5_2370278188084461998.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于嘉明…","content":"嘉明的工作颇有侠之风范。试想，功夫盖世的黑衣少年携手威武镇煞的瑞兽，在月黑风高夜，将盗贼与恶徒打得落花流水，狼狈而逃…等他得空，真想听他多分享一些走镖路途中的见闻。你也一起来吧？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/06/29/50494840/2d95a86dcf4be43fef448a5d5da88b1f_2198108006971511151.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"关于嘉明…en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其一","content":"阁下近来可好？如果闲来无事，可以来「万文集舍」转转。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0aea9227c1d45b6dd99b13b4ce1d50f_7244488897130618786.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其二","content":"问我为什么总是一个人看书？好学…并不是什么坏习惯吧。没有什么特别的地方，嗯，真的没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1d6a03efb83680089a573a92df8e9de0_3629283703109125690.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其三","content":"今天的时间已经空出来了吗？好，我也随时可以出发。书？没关系，书可以回来接着看，那些需要我们帮助的人可不能等啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/687762bd4f994fc490ff17085ce94879_1039771900876473692.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其四","content":"你说你有个好点子？用我们之前做的事情当原型，写一本探案集加武侠题材的小说，《万文集事件簿》？嗯，啊哈哈哈…是个好点子，但是不采纳。嗯，不会采纳的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0997228b57a166c329cd589b2a4445a8_5401092544179720121.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其五","content":"「洋洋万言，织诗成锦。」唉，我也想有这样的评价啊。这件事我只和你一个人说。其实，我也在写小说。现、现在当然不能给你看，以后…以后你会在书店里看到的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/542b45584a971966b1b179af84fb790d_8973752458468397945.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的爱好…","content":"我的爱好自然是看书。什么书都会看。嗯？你一脸坏笑看着我干什么。唔，那事我们两个知道就行了，还是不适合明面上讲。说出来就没意思了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eac635414af69edd7f2e95df0a09a971_8049414640951100640.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的烦恼…","content":"烦恼啊，嗯…未来有朝一日兄长继承了家业，我会怎么样呢？这样无忧无虑的生活恐怕…啊，我不是在说身份之类的，我不在乎那些。我是觉得大哥太呆了，没我帮忙不太行啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d7d47b2c1b43d4178a279ae4c1ca4aa8_8781845099328925630.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我比较喜欢吃糕点和月菜海鲜。主要是因为，我们家一直就吃得很清淡吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/df307299d342b3d58a65d56a32b05f9d_3490443344833749616.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我很讨厌胡萝卜，小时候家母经常捣碎胡萝卜做成…还是不要让我讲下去了。即使是在回忆里，那种味道也…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7f22e85e89582c4d92cd76a34709a7b9_4205148647048357222.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"此等美食，吃过一次就再难忘怀了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/bb63eeb897238688ea8431c338f1bbe5_8354371216286328711.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"既然你有这份手艺，不如我们开个路边餐馆，如何？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/4c8a7b45d4a1f5c3b150644799f93033_4223092260435606239.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你吃你吃，不必客气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/53f300ddcfd235b9a5fac23b96dd5db8_1559873459593449391.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·祝福","content":"咳，咳咳。恭祝你福寿与天齐，庆贺你生辰快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f2c1950cefe10ea2ac6f0ce646491594_8773927805011436855.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·习俗","content":"据记载，天成石桥是上古战争时候，岩之神摩拉克斯投出的石枪倒塌后形成的。要是生日当天在桥上走一趟，往两边海里投点摩拉，就能保佑一年安康…生日一年只有一次，想去的话就快点去吧…没骗你，是真的。真的，快去吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0172c18e81d0730483e4a4f388aea259_1238220961537649008.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"如果没有能力，那我心中的那个字，可能也就停在纸面上了吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f9290e70e1630caf6f29ebb3ffdfeb96_3604852040483549349.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"如果心中没有善恶的标尺，努力就会错了方向。舍本逐末，变成追逐暴力的俗人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/99ea8c432b92dd06fd4d4dd9ea9c6fbb_4866274802102838192.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"我所追求的那个字，在璃月这方土地上并非处处通行。不过行道至此，我对这一点早就有了足够的认识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c65f86beb8e8ae1b231d727459b58642_8387500739888830404.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"多亏了你的陪伴。我对自己也很满意了——无论是武学，还是对那个字的理解。唉，算啦。我也不用对「侠」字讳莫如深了。我的「侠」，父亲和兄长应该也不会质疑了。只不过嘛，低调行事这点还是得保留的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e622a0ef21d2528bfe82eeb664099566_5476592133793735847.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"雨线难画。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2572664270520fdaac3807faddb0ff39_8203174040734441993.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"裁——！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d8a99f2b87815b5feafa84d1cb264bd_4431107689441956914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"断！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33d160692c72c67af9e2b725bc189719_7849752091857760934.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"古华深秘。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ba9253375aae028067aeebe6eda38b6b_3211275504541193574.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"织诗成锦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4d4e583717fb762438a7a36c369dd004_331351503227216300.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"裁雨留虹。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c2f410f6031bf7282b458cefc92a545_2239200185419958604.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其一","content":"形随神至。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f50966961676b5c4ff02025c280209a1_2861183274097910997.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"冲刺开始·其二","content":"该行动了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c25d6be590feefd5f8aadd7cb8aa6dd2_4055394371269304234.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"甚好甚好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/196900cc02d881b11886a82568a12abe_7182419098381115752.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"寻得珍宝，真是充满侠意的经历。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c7b8d2dd37f979459aaec9fccbe14cdd_538461132595398505.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"倘若还有几卷失传的古书，就完满了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d5c50b89c71c7f13a8a45215274653ab_939364470995655272.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"计划有变…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2fe16385de5eaefe34b58563e2df11c6_8550251676613296654.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"接下来就不再是「点到为止」了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/459361f693c472b53f84ad537311fdfd_6911136045003744478.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"「请从绝处，读我侠义。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cea0228c03c9c6e1a47830e1dee554dd_7173736701784169450.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"过来这边，我有一计。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b244f348637668ab66a5e650ebed2145_4656778257416831500.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"小心行事为好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/11/04/16576950/8595e74183ee2958bec75571c10e5f24_6209524623423700794.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"承蒙…赐教…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd864cb33ca33296a85d7ca15be3e2d4_4433727206533646549.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"灯华易散…我是知道的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/487c0052667b8ae634c174f06f88a8da_2107140232702218432.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"失手了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb7069d1f76bf6025ca041d2eff1a7ac_2673311455815858378.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不妨事。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d81eb194ef5bf36811d05de3f721a73a_8567508336111524298.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"大意了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/384640f681cbdd3bfda27e17d22c3909_232645791542697965.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"不好…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9e15055ef235720431fd1a029a6f3ee4_2134647287546972415.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"厚积而薄发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3b4788207dc0684a1346c3c051e17b12_1057091516610650535.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"不惭世上英。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c55ef8d2831a0fb65fa35ad19e864453_5447665343123491525.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"扶善惩恶，当仁不让。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/beb36269fe0064db5f27a205dec36109_887552759953015131.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701365281501_3"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"在下行秋，不过书海一蠹。某虽不才，仍愿为君略尽绵薄。难得有机会说这种风格的台词，感觉还不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/10a37adf2234750824cae65a01624c61_1864076895101747591.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无人夜","content":"「有时明月无人夜，独向昭潭制恶龙。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8e357cd4761a50db5969480985d965e8_7258111568094189404.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·文章","content":"「衣裓贮文章，自言学雕虫。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d17b79f9ff3f906ac8267461a69a16f7_8290241066364430504.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·偷闲","content":"正所谓「偷得浮生半日闲」，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e81247bf623c9df639910d79825e35c2_275468288756118529.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·阅卷","content":"如此如此，这般这般…欸？欲知后事如何，且听下回分解？唔…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fbfb6dc545964796e9776cb8df9827dd_7512752156224928420.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·新书","content":"盘算着也该到「万文集舍」新进小说的日子了，不妨…我们顺道去看看？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f43674abd816730057c7fc16ec4f5f8_792046486729191282.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"这么说来，我们家出品的锦缎伞，好像既不能遮阳也不能挡雨。唯一的用处就是挂在墙上。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/742665cdd4337bf5e6766ec841820a8b_4281234637694631855.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"晴了就好，不然藏书会生霉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4a806b00d00a0847a03ebfbe40ada38d_1998327850995375347.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"只有这种天气的时候，我才会觉得家里比书店好。家里炭火很足，而书堆里就不准用火。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/28705d667ca877ccabd15f85241afac3_4137323935090543000.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"练功的好…啊不，是看书的好时节啊。好啦，我脸上又没有写字，别一直盯着我看了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4255ba2e6dfbd828819f2bda56734b28_2684953015656190785.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早啊。早上的时间这么难得，能做做自己喜欢的事情就好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/21f639e0daa49bbfa8b3b477602f52a8_2985954416839365360.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭有点不想吃米饭，想吃糕点。待在书斋吃，父亲和兄长就不知道了…嗯？想一起来吗？嗯…只要你不把碎屑沾到书上就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dacb1bbecc218db1e496737cb31c1157_7256749355325201453.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"去偷点萤火虫来看书，怎么样？唔，我的玩笑话你可别当真，对眼睛不好的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c43ead62ff8278c1b3e51862d1b491a2_4640913626566541582.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"明天我也在老地方。只要你不中途迷了路，就准能找得到我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/37ea74b022e3c8b42b1c37fb5229a45f_1650723461221755369.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋自己…","content":"在人前彬彬有礼，是因为大家见我是飞云商会的二少爷；在你面前能这么轻松，大概因为你看我的方式并不一样吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fe7426f9d02e6bf828beeb10a2f1d5be_4735516531870301679.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·书友","content":"你算是我的书友吧。什么？打架？古华派？战友？…唔！你都在说些什么呢。不是说好这是我们两人间的秘密吗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6a8845aaa0ba145c1f45c5067e826bbc_1746375176436750264.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·结拜","content":"我要和你结拜，就去绝云间的祭坛那边。不行，不能拒绝。你知道了我的底细，也就知道了一直被我掩饰着的真实的自己…我不能放你走。除非…你答应我不会撒手不干！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9e9508f4ec2b6d50ee9a88745f385d9a_7966153861708277460.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·古书","content":"「神之眼」的事情，虽然一般少有记载，但在我所收集的古书中却有一段特别的描述，待我找给你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1d8c7cc8ee6eb0f5a5a4dd9f5ee8e02c_41410928984090403.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」·领悟","content":"受书中启发，我领会到，枪术与剑术的本质，正是瞳术。唔，解释起来可能有点费力…如果你真想知道，就跟我去「王山厅」走一趟吧。事先声明，到时候你可不准笑。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e7448af5e99a299193c99d1a0ca0d1dd_8874180210035389695.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月非去不可的地方？这个问题很难回答，不过，如果消失了会让我很难过的地方…「万文集舍」稳排第一，「古华堂」能进前十吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7efa810626ba508fe6518e720ac2d574_2475785151577643781.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"以前是兔子，后来是鹿。对我来说，「请从绝处，读我侠义」是舍弃一切的觉悟，鹿却是绝处逢得新生的希望。真想再见它一次啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/36a73f0583c35b030a33b0ad85cc9d29_6219863321660376139.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"北斗阁下是我非常敬重的人。不过希望她不要喊我「小子」，也不要一见面就揉我头发。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/19a52813e132a8c535f402a1733d77d9_8039762140859083651.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"「天权」大人是我不得不敬重的人。不然会给家父以及家兄添麻烦。嗯？对她本人，我想想。嗯…还是算了，不说人坏话了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/524bf461be43741e8d3177443f2074bf_4177468169557488665.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/98f8d1528cd92ec80da8f1190171f784_1506870703155544697.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cb30f8f9489742dcf8a75687ec927b39_2642498819959344595.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"那个小姑娘，正是「往生堂」的当代堂主。嗯？问我怎样看待她的为人？…行事作风嘛，坊间传闻是作不了数的。真想了解一个人，还得看她真正想要的是什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/825109b125124b19fd199e66cbe19e94_6027563822536842595.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"总感觉七七的身上藏着谜团。但只要白术先生在场，就跟她说不上几句话。除非，我们能找个白术先生外出看诊的机会，专门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/12b30379a375cfcb4b1efc9590d7c3b1_4215944094044221549.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"见到香菱的时候，你可得多观察一下她的表情。尤其是刚刚添置完食材回来的香菱，笑得越开心，就越危险。要是被她缠上、逼你试吃新品…这种情况，我一般会靠重云来处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0af101c165b0e886b9fde84a2de5961_1706982164481916260.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"辛焱到底是在哪里演出的？从吃虎岩到玉京台，哪里都躲不过那种鸡飞狗跳的穿透力…唉，能够安静看书的时日是多么宝贵啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e7cc9467dbbe88299e3cd8c3e70916ad_4682559774981202843.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"下一卷、下下卷、下下下卷的重要场景，我都已经想好要配怎样的插画了！啊，必须赶快把灵感记下来，修书一封，寄给白垩老师…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/83b3173224870a941badcc37ec612203_5369118688722906098.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我看见过家父和家兄接待这位先生，就从他们行礼时候的恭敬态度来看…对方应该是很有地位的人物吧。我还听说他是给仙人办丧事的人，感觉很有底蕴。要不要一起去挖掘他身上的秘密呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c2ed1184378dc9ba5bc87b65bcf6c9ad_4575997966258804136.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c6f0deab8b1c1651bdcf1048e5173039_8146226009707281746.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"你听说过「一人千面」这个词语吗？夜兰小姐就给我这种感觉。上门来访的时候，家父和家兄以礼相待，她也还之以礼，就像是个亲切稳重的大姐姐。可在别的地方见到她时，又完全是不同的印象。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d1c4ff7543dd9cec3ed5fa5860cf87b_7867021271372191342.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于嘉明…","content":"嘉明的工作颇有侠之风范。试想，功夫盖世的黑衣少年携手威武镇煞的瑞兽，在月黑风高夜，将盗贼与恶徒打得落花流水，狼狈而逃…等他得空，真想听他多分享一些走镖路途中的见闻。你也一起来吧？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/06/29/50494840/5cbc01b18dc73a67fab2f826393a3d2b_2757314245693024712.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"关于嘉明…kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其一","content":"阁下近来可好？如果闲来无事，可以来「万文集舍」转转。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/34850085cd335baacf0bab56f0e60cdf_916469609280649930.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其二","content":"问我为什么总是一个人看书？好学…并不是什么坏习惯吧。没有什么特别的地方，嗯，真的没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dac3b0096f495e777db27dbfc6c42cea_6005940040468929173.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其三","content":"今天的时间已经空出来了吗？好，我也随时可以出发。书？没关系，书可以回来接着看，那些需要我们帮助的人可不能等啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5e7326417484a8d529bc3413b4bc2dfd_3791710766376289871.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其四","content":"你说你有个好点子？用我们之前做的事情当原型，写一本探案集加武侠题材的小说，《万文集事件簿》？嗯，啊哈哈哈…是个好点子，但是不采纳。嗯，不会采纳的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/238835ab780ae415ea699dac377fb929_638368396518188989.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解行秋·其五","content":"「洋洋万言，织诗成锦。」唉，我也想有这样的评价啊。这件事我只和你一个人说。其实，我也在写小说。现、现在当然不能给你看，以后…以后你会在书店里看到的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/470bfc8e06da5ba535664f5b70fc8d76_6338823346044833307.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的爱好…","content":"我的爱好自然是看书。什么书都会看。嗯？你一脸坏笑看着我干什么。唔，那事我们两个知道就行了，还是不适合明面上讲。说出来就没意思了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/50ef26dd182b10a60cca05a4853e310d_4153596289730048428.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"行秋的烦恼…","content":"烦恼啊，嗯…未来有朝一日兄长继承了家业，我会怎么样呢？这样无忧无虑的生活恐怕…啊，我不是在说身份之类的，我不在乎那些。我是觉得大哥太呆了，没我帮忙不太行啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/29c0c472fe6ba742872c299263d5a602_5652271075497209700.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我比较喜欢吃糕点和月菜海鲜。主要是因为，我们家一直就吃得很清淡吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/72eacb8694432ce28fe92e39a88d3ed8_7967363746360354187.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我很讨厌胡萝卜，小时候家母经常捣碎胡萝卜做成…还是不要让我讲下去了。即使是在回忆里，那种味道也…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/354c743603acd4e81ece42fa31aad501_2841458357578638520.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"此等美食，吃过一次就再难忘怀了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/436d4b86c8feb683987c790233421c19_7381746218969981317.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"既然你有这份手艺，不如我们开个路边餐馆，如何？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/735e185c9bf511f82b6e581b2c953271_8480049269244926698.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你吃你吃，不必客气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/7d1bdad42051463e911d6a22de2ac3be_20391428531201136.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·祝福","content":"咳，咳咳。恭祝你福寿与天齐，庆贺你生辰快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/668a40f7d2c11cfd7511741592915f45_2536626495899106627.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日·习俗","content":" 对行秋来说，「偷得浮生半日闲」可以指代很多意思。

有时指的是去「万文集舍」看新进的小说；

有时指的是去「和裕茶馆」缠着云堇老板开发新饮料。

而在某些特别的时候，指的是「独自行侠仗义」。

击败拦路的恶匪、赶走捣乱的怪物、帮哭泣的孩子摘下挂在树梢上的风筝…这一切都在行秋「行侠仗义」的范围之内。

就像武侠逸间中广为流传的「微服私访」故事那样在某些冒险的尽头， 行秋并不在乎动用飞云商会的力量来解决一些武力之外的问题。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

某日，行秋的大哥前来寻他，屋内却没有人在。回来后，行秋遇到了候在走廊上的大哥。

「你房内太过凌乱，我便自作主张替你收拾了一番。

行秋啊，你与大哥同样肩负着飞云商会的名声，理应为众人作出表率。

岂能不知一屋不扫，何以扫天下？昔年仙人有云…」

对着行秋唠叨半小时后，大哥终于放过了他，临走前留下一句奇怪的话：

「下次，大哥不会未经许可进入你房间了，丫鬟那边我也会提点一句。」

行秋一头雾水， 不知该作何回答。离去的大哥却在转身后换上一副惆怅面孔，自言自语道：

「床底下还藏了书…嗯…大哥可不会去看那是什么书的。哎，行秋也长大啦，以后会不会嫌我的管教太啰嗦呢？这叫做什么来着…青春期，是吗？」

行秋也很奇怪。他藏了这么多武侠小说，早已做好与帮佣们斗智斗勇的准备，可为什么一直没人来探查他的房间呢？

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

为了不让行秋成日泡在绯云坡的书店「万文集舍」里，老爹允许他前往「古华派」学武。

不过，行秋很快发现，「古华派」只是没落已久的小门派，压根给不出像样的教导，就连报名用的豪华道场也是临时租借而来，根本不归门派所有。

老爹当然也知道这一点。他只是想让行秋学一些华而不实的剑术，聊以娱乐。

出乎意料的是，博闻强识、通读古书的行秋已经达到一法通万法通的境界。他在「古华派」修习，凭借自身知识辅以古籍记载，彻底振兴了衰退已久的古华武术。

初入门的行秋曾对古华派武术感到失望。然而，门人善使的「小术」完全符合他的渴望。

灰粉、烟雾砂、纸鱼游水、吞剑吐火…生在商贾之家，行秋就是喜欢这种琳琅满目的选择感。

当即决定花上十天半月，将古华派一百门江湖奇术学全。行秋认为，这对行侠仗义而言也是种极有力的补充。

剑客少爷行秋，人前静若处子，人后动若脱兔，对着亲近的人则会变得唠叨。虽说还不及大哥，却也足够调皮捣蛋了。

而这般古灵精怪个性的主要受害者，是一位出没在璃月山林带的少年方士——重云。

「重云啊重云，昨日我为你找到一座闹鬼的凶宅，快去练练手吧。」

「重云啊重云，你千万要相信我，那间凶宅里的机关不是我布置的…什么？你说根本不是凶宅？嗯，这倒不是我能预料的事…」

「重云啊重云，何必用那种眼神瞪我呢？瞧你身上都青一块紫一块了，还是好好躺着吧。」

「重云啊重云，我家有个丫鬟，曾在须弥国贵族府中研习精油理疗秘术。我找她来帮你推拿筋骨，你可要领我这份大情呀…」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

「侠义」一词，释义因人而异。

自由仗义者为侠，善恶分明者为侠，一身正气者为侠…

但在行秋看来，「 侠义」的意义，仅仅是做好事、做好人。

身为璃月港巨贾之后，行秋的本分是在生意场里摸爬滚打，「侠义」二字，本该与他渐行渐远。

但在「神之眼」的帮助下，他开始办成一桩又一桩曾经只能向往的「传奇轶事」。

商会的事自然不能放下，但只要能亲自行侠仗义，哪怕只是偶尔，也已让行秋倍感满足。

唯一会削减行秋笑容的，只有他人口中对那些「侠士」动机的庸俗猜测。

地位、名利、暗中交易…当听到有人如此编排侠客的本心，行秋面上波澜不惊，心中却已将那人列入黑名单，放在比最讨厌吃的胡萝卜更低的位置。

行秋以自身经历为素材，撰写了一部武侠小说《沉秋拾剑录》，想要在璃月港出版。

不料，却被璃月港的出版机构以「设定过于离谱，剧情却意外地俗套，没人会喜欢」为由拒了稿。

不服气的行秋自己印了几本，偷偷放在常去的书店「万文集舍」里，然而，确实没人爱看，令他颇受打击。

行秋不知道的是，路过的稻妻客商看到这本书，买下一本带回稻妻国，竟在当地广受好评。稻妻文人争相模仿，却无一部能超越《沉秋拾剑录》。自此这本书便在稻妻文坛常驻一席之地。

数百年来，武学门派「古华派」式微。辉煌时期，「古华派」曾以枪剑闻名璃月。

相传，其有三大镇派秘术——枪法「刺明法」、剑法「裁雨法」，以及枪剑双绝的「生克法」。此三绝之术随代代传承不断精进，时光推移，三绝技巧渐臻化境，威力

却不断削弱，导致古华派势力低迷，人心流散…三绝更是如尘埃中的宝库，静候一位继承者。

多年后，尘封的古华派等来了行秋。数百年间，唯有他一人仅仅花费四年便悟出了传古承今的「武理」。

古华枪剑讲究「如臂使指」，在璃月诸派武术中，这是相当常见的意识。而依行秋之见，枪与剑的运用，其根本是对于「神之眼」的运用。武人应将「神之眼」视为身体的延伸，枪与剑则又是「神之眼」的延伸。即是说：枪术与剑术的本质，乃是瞳术。

行秋参悟此道，挥毫写就武理歌诀一篇。古华派家主观之落泪，当即宣布：「并非行秋需要古华派，而是古华派需要行秋。」自此，这篇歌诀被供奉在古华派重地「王山厅」，不许弟子瞻仰，外人更是无从得见。

以下为歌诀全文：

我习古华久，深秘我已悉。古华枪剑长浮锈，今日溶洗与尔知。

古华之剑华，如雨若飘华。飘华可撷取，雨线人难画。古华之枪华，灼灼灯华。灯华易脆散，复聚如燃霞。

如燃霞，三尺光，何辉煌。人谓使剑如使指，我言剑光是目光。

游离物外无重量，裁雨者雨，刺明者明。

动若龙蛇捉摸不定，青眼如剑，侧目似枪。

——其实，歌诀内容本应对所有弟子公开，封存真迹的原因只是字实在太丑了。

角色

关于行秋…

刻晴

我听说过他的故事，明明出身名门望族，却不爱家族事业，喜欢去外面行侠仗义。我很欣赏他，毕竟，把家里的条条框框丢到一边，执意去做心中认为正确的事，这种魄力，可不是谁都有的。

重云

我虽然敬佩行秋的武艺和侠心。但是我一定要事先提醒你，他坏心思也不少。如果真的发生了什么事情，记得回来和我结成受害者同盟啊。

凝光

飞云商会的二公子，那种性格的人看不惯我，是很自然的，而我也不会去为难他。「道不同不相为谋」，说的就是这个道理。

阿贝多

行秋吗？他写的小说挺有趣的。稻妻那边的「八重堂」一直在旁敲侧击希望让我和别的作者合作，说这样版税收入也会更好。哼，我缺这点钱吗？

甘雨

飞云商会那位青衣少年，并不像他的父亲和兄长那般操心织物的经营。是因为对他来说，有更重要的事情值得去做吧。当然…这也只是我的猜测…

烟绯

飞云商会是我的老主顾了。他家行事一向慎重周全，与我的商谈通常由大当家亲自出面。不过，上一次却碰巧见到了他家小少爷行秋。这位少爷年纪轻轻，没想到居然跟得上我思考的速度。伶牙俐齿还分寸得当，嗯，真不简单。

胡桃

听说行秋少爷在写书？话本还是怪谈呢？好想把平日遇见的杂事说给他听，写成书一定很好看吧。

申鹤

我曾见到他凑在你耳旁不知说些什么。若他敢威胁你，我一定会将他…嗯？只是朋友间的玩闹话？当真如此吗…

云堇

原来你也认识行秋。哈哈，他聪明得很，鬼主意那么多，怕是一不留神就会捉弄你，可得留个心眼啊。

夜兰

我当然记得他，飞云商会家的小少爷。我经常和他们家来往。也许以后，他也会成为眼观六路的能人呢？

嘉明

飞云商会是镖局的老主顾了，印象中一直都是他们的大少爷在打理生意上的事情，有次行秋少爷难得主动问起镖物的事，我就一五一十地将飞云商会最近货物的路线和收发日子告诉他，结果他问的是能不能透露一下万文集舍最新那批货什么时候到，哈哈哈。

蓝砚

我曾在山林里偶遇过行秋少爷几回，他身边没有飞云商会的伙计跟着，看起来不像在办公事…在那以后他时不时会给我送几本最新出版的志怪小说，请我帮他保守秘密。完了…我是不是不小心说出来了…这下请你帮我们俩都保守住秘密啊！

常九爷

【在大世界中与NPC对话，选择“那以后怎么样了？”-“关于行秋…”（需要完成行秋传说任务锦织之章）】

  • 古华派的那小子，自那以后我就没见过他了，现在八成也在做些莫名其妙的事吧。

  • 不过我总觉得有点古怪，他的身份可能没那么简单…

  • 算了，和我也没什么关系。

主题：行到闲处…

发件人：行秋

时间：2026-10-09

你或许不知道，最近这段时间，我可是被家里给练惨了，又是跟着商队四处游历，又是陪着大哥去见生意伙伴…看我累得不行，大哥就私下和我说，如果我不愿意的话，那他便去和家里人再说说。

我见他眼角的皱纹如山岳裂谷，鬓角也不知何时落下了雪色…我不愿意四个字，却是怎么也说不出口了。

侠之大者，为家为国，为义为理…可不能只为了自己啊。

在这之后，我会跟着大哥正式学习，和他共同打理家里的事务。到时候我可能就真要忙昏头了。

但现在，我还是偷出了一日闲暇，若是你有空的话，不如和我一起坐坐？再喝几杯茶，就当作…

呵，送我去做大侠？

主题：常看常新…

发件人：行秋

时间：2025-10-09

天清云透，真是晒书的好时节。可风一掀页，墨香混着陈纸气息扑面而来，我呀，便不由自主挨着石阶坐下了，晾书席反成了读书榻。没想到批注过的句子，重读时又生了新枝。「常看常新」四字，此刻才当真嚼出滋味来。

日影西斜方才回过神来，周遭散落着翻到一半的文集，晾书绳空悬，书箱却仍满满当当…

我只好对天许诺:未理的残卷——统统托付给明日的行秋吧。

而最当紧的，是心头这点雀跃的痒意。想寻个知音，沏开两盖新茶，道一道这新悟的典故、久藏的轶闻、半截没头没尾的江湖诗…阁下若得闲可愿来一聚？

主题：提笔相助…

发件人：行秋

时间：2024-10-09

数日前，有一孩童求我教他舞剑，嚷着要当大侠。为人师长，岂敢儿戏？我自知欠缺火候，又不忍浇灭他眼中的星光，可谓两难…

阁下见多识广，可否劳烦你前来一聚，共商良策？

哈哈，唉，我知道这番说辞骗不了你，来龙去脉我交代完整便是。确有孩童拜师一事，此前我已提议赠他几本武侠小说，待他读毕，倘若侠心依旧，我便助他另觅良师，他也欣然同意了。只不过，他另有一愿，希望我在书中给他写上寄语，以作激励…

这…这…唉！个中苦闷，我想唯有阁下明了…

客栈雅间，美味佳肴，以及…文房四宝我已安排妥当，盼望阁下提笔相助，不胜感激！

主题：我有一计…

发件人：行秋

时间：2023-10-09

近来，我路见一名债务处理人勒索商户，便上前制止了一番。没想到他才败在我的剑下不久，今日却又跳了出来，到处扬言要找我决斗。

这厮心术不正，此番邀约，必有埋伏。但若是我直接回绝，他今后恐怕会更加器张跋扈。

思前想后，我有一计——我公开应邀，另设奇兵藏于暗处，伺机捕捉证据。等时机一到，这名奇兵便可现身为我解围，再与我联手，将这厮和他的同伙一网打尽。

至于我想到的奇兵…这首选之人便要数身手不凡、心怀侠义的阁下。

报酬和吃食早已备好，静候阁下应约。

主题：见字如面。

发件人：行秋

时间：2022-10-09

近来新得一柄长剑，锋利无匹，是难得一见的宝器。

而所谓宝剑，绝不应被束之高阁，得跟着一个合格的主人闯荡江湖才不算埋没。

唉，明明是大好年华…

我又怎会甘心在家虚度呢？

我制定了个周密的计划，想趁着月夜，去那绝云间走一趟！盘缠和吃食都备好了，只等今晚父亲兄长歇下，我就溜出家门。

这计划还得有个知心人接应，你懂我意思吧？

我已将长剑随身携带，到时候，也给你掌掌眼。

主题：再得佳期。

发件人：行秋

时间：2021-10-09

你可记得今天是什么日子？

若无头绪，这道点心便是提示。看见就能想起来了吧。

为让你耳目一新，我可是花了好长时间改良配方。你且尝一口。

唉…本想将这封信藏在点心盒底，又担心你懒得拆开盒子细看。错过就太可惜了。

下次请你吃鱼好了。届时你可得留个心眼，说不定鱼腹中就藏着什么呢。

另外，近日觅得妙文一篇，据说有一金发旅者浑身正气，行走世间办下诸多好事，引得街坊邻里交口称赞。文章言之凿凿，但是否言过其实…这嘛，还得等你亲自前来品鉴。

今夜子时，屋顶上等你。

主题：就我们两个人！

发件人：行秋

时间：2020-10-09

今天是我的生日，家父和家兄说什么要办家宴，怎么都推托不了。

又是要我给客人盈酒沏茶，又是要我在席上表演才艺，好生无趣。

还好我趁他们一个不注意偷偷从窗户外溜出来了，嘿嘿。

我给你带了点我亲手做的点心，你可不要说漏嘴了哦。

我们去找个没人的地方吧！一边看风景一边聊聊天…聊什么都行！你说好不好？
